answer: Each identity locks a 70 bond and must, every tide, forge an output and file its plume receipt to the tide ledger. Renewal fees follow filing order: the kth renewal pays 10+2(k-1) credits, so the 1,000th costs 2,008 and 1,000 renewals in one tide cost 1,009,000 plus 70,000 locked. Missing a tide lapses the identity and burns its bond; its expired plume receipt cannot revive it. A ring reusing one plume output across identities fails: the auditor recomputes receipts against the forge ledger and burns bonds for duplicates. An honest identity locks 70 once and pays 10 per tide.
